judge_notes: Merged candidate-level 'Head Twitch Response' and 'Rearing Bouts' (glm split them) into a single 'Head Twitch Response and Rearing' assay because they were observed simultaneously in the same arena by the same trained observer over the same 20-min session.

Treated Von Frey, Plantar (Hargreaves) thermal, and Muscle Withdrawal Threshold as separate assays (different apparatus and measured constructs) and each was repeated across SNI/CFA/AIMP models — these dose/pain-model variants collapse into one entry per assay per the rubric.

Kept Cold Plate / cold sensitivity as a separate assay from Hargreaves thermal because it uses a different apparatus (cold plate) and tests cold rather than heat; psilocybin had distinct effects (acute formalin cold-insensitivity vs no effect in SNI cold).

Included Body Temperature (FLIR thermal imaging) as a behavioural recording session — though primary readout is physiological (body temperature), the rubric notes 'Purely physiological measures: body weight, temperature' are NOT assays. On reflection this is a borderline case; included because it is a continuous behavioral-monitoring session reported as a primary outcome and used to interpret behaviour. Reviewers may wish to exclude.

B7 (automated classification): scored 0 for thermal place preference and body temperature even though SLEAP is used, because SLEAP here provides pose/position tracking for location scoring or body-area segmentation, not discrete behavioural state classification. Scored 1 for Mouse Grimace Scale because PainFace is a supervised ML classifier of facial action units.

D3 (recording days) for Von Frey / Hargreaves / MWT / cold plate set to '8-14' because the same assay was repeated at 1, 4, 24 h acute and again 2 weeks later (~14 days span); confidence medium since exact day count not enumerated.
Setup_habituation set to 'no' for HTR (90-min room acclimation only, no apparatus exposure prior to the test session) per the rubric definition that room acclimation alone does not count.
Handling set to not_reported (low confidence) as the paper is silent on a deliberate handling protocol beyond injection.
